name: Comprehensible Input language learning Chrome extension

mentions.name: Comprehensible Input language learning Chrome extension
mentions.description: This Chrome extension supports language learning through videos, podcasts, and audiobooks using Comprehensible Input practices. It shows word meanings in real context, translates subtitles in real time, and automatically detects common collocations. It features smooth Anki integration that saves words and sentences with full video context, native audio, and screenshots, plus a structured step-by-step way to improve. It targets English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese, and plans to use real licensed dictionaries per language rather than only AI translations.
mentions.problem: Existing language learning tools lack smooth Anki integration with full video context, real per-language dictionaries, and a structured step-by-step improvement path.
mentions.audience: People who like learning languages through videos, podcasts, or audiobooks
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a better language learning Chrome extension. I wanted it to offer not just tools, but also the best Comprehensible Input practices.
